name: mirror shield
_design_note: A named counter (src/counters.py, winning-build plan 3.3): a gaze slides off it, no damage and no rider. Its price is the AC a kite or tower shield would give. Metal only, polished. The fourth bell number is its height beside the other shields (gear.template_weight): rarer than a kite shield at its peak.
lore_template: When Perseus went against the sleeping Gorgon he walked backward, watching her in such a shield as this, and never once did he meet her eyes. This round {material_name} shield has neither boss nor device, and is polished until it shows the room behind you like still water. It will turn a gaze but not a blade, being thinner than a war shield.
